note: GA-104 (Code Editor D1): the new tokens for design/tokens.json's color.tokens, in its format. F0 adds them after c-grey and runs node scripts/tokens-css.ts.

tokens.name: diff-add
tokens.usage: Added: the + mark and the line number of an added line, + counts (+964), the A status letter. Text on bg, raised, selected and diff-add-soft.

tokens.name: diff-del
tokens.usage: Removed: the − mark and the old line number of a removed line, − counts (−112), the D status letter. Text on bg, raised, selected and diff-del-soft.

tokens.name: diff-add-soft
tokens.usage: Behind an added line, its number and its + mark.

tokens.name: diff-del-soft
tokens.usage: Behind a removed line, its old number and its − mark.

tokens.name: diff-add-strong
tokens.usage: Behind the characters that changed inside an added line, drawn over diff-add-soft.

tokens.name: diff-del-strong
tokens.usage: Behind the characters that changed inside a removed line, drawn over diff-del-soft.

tokens.name: diff-fold
tokens.usage: The fold bar between changes ("37 unchanged lines", ↑ 20, ↓ 20), with text-2 on it.

tokens.name: syn-keyword
tokens.usage: Keywords (fn, function, return, if, pub, use, const), self and this, Blade's directives (@if, @foreach, @php).

tokens.name: syn-meta
tokens.usage: <?php and ?>, Blade's {{ }} and {!! !!}, attributes (#[derive], #[Route]), decorators, escapes.

tokens.name: syn-function
tokens.usage: Functions and methods, where they're defined and called; macros (println!).

tokens.name: syn-tag
tokens.usage: HTML, Blade and JSX tags (div, x-button, Sidebar).

tokens.name: syn-type
tokens.usage: Types, classes, structs, enums, interfaces, namespaces; Rust's lifetimes.

tokens.name: syn-attribute
tokens.usage: Attribute names in HTML, Blade and JSX (class, wire:model, onClick).

tokens.name: syn-string
tokens.usage: Strings, characters, template strings, regular expressions, attribute values.

tokens.name: syn-number
tokens.usage: Numbers, true, false and null: literals, with the strings.

tokens.name: syn-comment
tokens.usage: Comments, doc comments and Blade's {{-- --}}.

tokens.name: syn-variable
tokens.usage: Variables and other names; the text of HTML and JSX.

tokens.name: syn-property
tokens.usage: Properties and fields ($this->total, task.title, self.files), JSON and YAML keys.

tokens.name: syn-operator
tokens.usage: Operators (= + -> => && ?:).

tokens.name: syn-punctuation
tokens.usage: Brackets, commas, semicolons, < > around tags.

tokens.name: syn-invalid
tokens.usage: What the parser can't read (an unclosed tag): with a wavy underline, so it isn't colour alone.
